Name: Seasonal Industrial Mailboxes
Author: grapefruitcult
Description:
?????????? ???????? ?????????
this is my first mod bahah, i tried my best and i rly wanted to get smth out!! this is just a small little industrial modern looking mailbox - inspired by industrial furniture - that has various flowerly lil changes each season!!
pls report bugs/give feedback and pls give endorsements, id really appreciate both as it will help me get better as a modder <33

☆ installation //
1. download & install content patcher and smapi
2. download mod
3. unzip into StardewValley/Mods
4. change mailbox type in config
huzzah!

 ☆ config //
version: "seasonal" (default), "clean" (no flowers, no seasonal change)

 ☆ screenshots //
mods used in screenshot:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050]just another map recolour[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3511]eemie's victorian buildings[/url]

that's all, enjoy <3
